The module contract

Source: CONTRACT.md

A module is a function the package runs through a registry: an extractor, cleaner, segmenter, reader or embedder, or a module of your own. The module contract is what the core requires of a module and what a conformance check reports about it. Its version is what hr_contract_version() returns (internal, in R/core-registry-contract.R):

Current version: 0.1

What the version covers

  1. Kinds of module. A layer tells the core about a kind with hr_register_kind(name, ...). The core keeps name and whatever else is given (the document layer gives registry, the name of the registry its modules are kept in). The document layer registers five kinds at load: extractor, cleaner, segmenter, reader and embedder.
  2. The conformance report. hr_check_module(fn, run, rules, kind, name) returns an hr_conformance data frame with the columns rule, ok (TRUE, FALSE, or NA for a rule not checked) and detail (one string, "" when there is nothing to say), and the attributes kind, name, contract (this version) and warnings. The first two rows are always is_function and runs. A rule returns TRUE, FALSE or NA, or a list with ok and detail.
  3. The reader rules (gr_check_reader()): answer_class, answer_fields (the answer has answer, reader, question, chunks_used, partial, notes, trace, warnings and signature, and partial is one TRUE or FALSE), answer_text, evidence, chunks_used, calls_declared and calls_within_cost.
  4. The segmenter rules (gr_check_segmenter()): chunks_class, chunk_columns (chunk_id, text, tokens, chars, page, section and block_id), chunk_text, chunk_ids, within_cap and calls_declared.

The version is recorded where a result depends on it: in the contract attribute of every conformance report, and in the contract_version field of the key of a signal calibration (hr_calibrate_signal()), which is filled with the current version when the key leaves it out.

Rules for changing it

  • Any change to the fields above (a kind added or removed, a column or attribute of the report, a rule added, removed, renamed or made stricter) bumps the minor version: 0.1 to 0.2. A change that touches none of them, such as a clearer detail message, does not.
  • Each bump gets an entry below that lists every field that changed.
  • The version is pinned in tests/testthat/test-core-kinds.R, and tests/testthat/test-contract-files.R checks that the current version at the top of this file is the one hr_contract_version() returns. Change all three together.
  • Once the conformance checks have passed for two releases in a row, the fields are frozen, and 1.0 follows.

Changelog

Unreleased

No field changes; the version stays 0.1. Checked on 2026-11-22 against the commit that added the conformance checks (b40139e): hr_check_module(), the report, hr_register_kind() and the reader and segmenter rules are unchanged since. The calibration key started recording contract_version in this period; that records the version and does not change the contract.

0.1 (2026-11-05)

The first version, with the core’s own state and registry of kinds (2184208). The conformance report and the reader and segmenter rules followed on 2026-11-06 (b40139e), under the same version. All fields above as listed.
